chapters.decision: Keep the name Ecclesiastes, king of Israel, the repeated futility formula, surplus/toil and the sun-to-wind transition across 5–6. Preserve the future filling/seeing/hearing clauses, comparisons and understanding in 17 and knowledge rather than grief in 18. Modernize verbs and add clear speech punctuation in 10. Resolve of spirit remains a provisional lexical rendering, not an inserted wind-chasing paraphrase. The future hypothetical speaker in Greek 10 is expressed by the English if anyone speaks construction.

Preserve the contextual God-reference apart from Him in 25.
